prior_rule: NO VERIFIED IMAGE = NO PUBLIC DESTINATION (from early bootstrap stage)
operational_reality: All 179 default leisure destinations in Odisha database are legitimate cultural destinations. 70 have verified authentic photography; 109 are currently undergoing field photographic verification.

reconciled_policy.DESTINATION_PUBLICATION: Decoupled from media verification. All 179 verified cultural and leisure destinations are publicly browsable in O-TRAVELZ.
reconciled_policy.MEDIA_PUBLICATION: Strictly gated. UNVERIFIED_MEDIA_MUST_NEVER_RENDER_PUBLICLY. No stock photos, no AI imagery, no cross-destination photo borrowing.
reconciled_policy.MISSING_MEDIA_BEHAVIOR: Destinations pending photographic verification display an editorial cultural typography card in warm Sunlit Sandstone / Deep Basalt with prominent Odia calligraphy.
